caption: What if your speed doubled every 2 seconds? Start with a 5 km/h walk. At 8 seconds you're at 80 km/h, overtaking autos. At 12 seconds you hit 320 km/h, the planned top operating speed of India's Mumbai-Ahmedabad bullet train. At 16 seconds you pass the speed of sound (about 1,225 km/h at sea level) and drag a sonic boom behind you. By 20 seconds you're above Mach 4, and the air squeezed in front of you heats up like a meteor's. At 26 seconds you beat 40,320 km/h, Earth's escape velocity of 11.2 km/s. Around 53 seconds you'd zip past the Moon, 384,400 km away. But the speed of light, about 300,000 km per second, stays out of reach: in Einstein's relativity, nothing with mass can ever get there. At what second would YOU hit the brakes? 👇
